verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a first-party interactive API reference or explorer with runnable examples for Adyen Agentic. The GitHub OpenAPI repo only suggests uploading the definitions to third-party Swagger Editor or SwaggerHub, which is a user-side workaround, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate docs path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
